armyRule.name: Acts of Faith
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is ADEPTA SORORITAS, each unit from your army with this ability can perform one Act of Faith per phase. This is done using Miracle dice.

### Gaining Miracle Dice
If your Army Faction is ADEPTA SORORITAS, you gain 1 Miracle dice:
▪ At the start of each turn.
▪ Each time an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army is destroyed.

Each time you gain a Miracle dice, roll one D6. The number you roll is the value of that Miracle dice. This value cannot be changed or re-rolled, unless a rule specifically states otherwise. Keep your Miracle dice to one side — this is your Miracle dice pool.

### Performing an Act of Faith
Before making a dice roll for a model or unit from your army with the Acts of Faith ability, if you have one or more dice in your Miracle dice pool, that unit can perform an Act of Faith. If it does, select one of the dice from your Miracle dice pool to substitute that dice roll (if a roll involves more than one dice, e.g. a Charge roll or Battle-shock test, only a single dice can be substituted). The dice that is being substituted is not rolled; instead, the value of the selected Miracle dice is used as if it had been rolled (this counts as an unmodified dice roll of that value for all rules purposes). Each Miracle dice can only be selected for substitution once. Once all Miracle dice substitutions have been made, remove the chosen Miracle dice from your Miracle dice pool, and roll all remaining, unsubstituted dice that are apart of the dice roll. You can use Miracle dice when a unit performs an Act of Faith for any of the following types of dice roll:
▪ Advance roll
▪ Battle-shock test
▪ Charge roll
▪ Damage roll
▪ Hit roll
▪ Saving throw
▪ Wound roll

detachments.name: Army of Faith
detachments.ruleBody: Each ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase, instead of just one.

stratagems.name: Shield of Faith
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit, or one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds. If you targeted an ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army with this Stratagem, then until the end of the phase, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 3" of your unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Faith and Fury
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of your unit's attacks this phase, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

stratagems.name: Divine Guidance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of any of those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

stratagems.name: Light of the Emperor
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is blessed. While a unit is blessed, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws). If your unit has the JUMP PACK keyword, until the end of the turn, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 3" of your unit, that friendly unit is also blessed.

stratagems.name: Angelic Descent
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place to into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Blinding Radiance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, or one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3" of such a unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If you targeted an ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army with this Stratagem, then until the end of the phase, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY unit is within 3" of your unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

detachments.name: Bringers of Flame
detachments.ruleBody: Ranged weapons equipped by ADEPTA SORORITAS models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time an attack made with such a weapon targets a unit within 6", add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Blazing Ire
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: One unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, and can then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

stratagems.name: Rites of Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 6" that is also within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Cleansing Flames
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability

stratagems.name: Righteous Blows
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of attacks made by those weapons this phase, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Shield of Aversion
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Carry Forth the Faithful
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before an ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT model from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT model.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your TRANSPORT, and units can disembark from your TRANSPORT even though it Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move, and cannot declare a charge this turn

detachments.name: Champions of Faith
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Command phase, you can select up to 3 ADEPTA SORORITAS units from your army (including units that are embarked within TRANSPORTS), until the start of your next Command phase, those units are Righteous. While a unit is Righteous:
▪ Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
▪ Improve the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.
▪ Improve the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD, CELESTIAN INSIDIANTS, CELESTIAN SACRESANTS and PARAGON WARSUITS models in that unit by 1.

stratagems.name: To the Heart of Heresy
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Path of the Righteous
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, if your unit is Righteous, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Bastion of Faith
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Celestian Sacresants unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. In addition, if your unit is Righteous, you can select one other CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked and is within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll as well.

stratagems.name: Shield of Denial
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability against mortal wounds. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds instead.

stratagems.name: Suffer Not the Unfaithful
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that is Righteous and that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

stratagems.name: Indefatigable Dedication
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

detachments.name: Hallowed Martyrs
detachments.ruleBody: Each time an ADEPTA SORORITAS model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model’s unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model’s unit is Below Half-strength.

stratagems.name: Righteous Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and, if your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Divine Intervention
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER model from your army that was just **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just **destroyed**.
stratagems.effect: You can discard 1-3 Miracle dice. At the end of the phase, set up that model on the battlefield, **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** and as close as possible to where it was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**. That model is not part of an **[gloss:attached-unit:attached]** unit and its unit has a **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]** of 1. Roll one D3, adding 1 to the result for each Miracle dice you discarded. That model has that number of wounds remaining (up to its starting number of wounds).
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select Saint Celestine as the target of this Stratagem. You cannot select the same CHARACTER as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Suffering and Sacrifice
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY or ADEPTA SORORITAS WALKER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects its targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Immolation
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though It was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

stratagems.name: Spirit of the Martyr
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Praise the Fallen
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

detachments.name: Penitent Host
detachments.ruleBody:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the following Vows of Atonement to be active for your army until the start of your next Command phase. You can only select each Vow of Atonement once per battle.
The Path of the Penitent

Add 3" to the Move characteristic of PENITENT models from your army.

Absolution in Battle

Each time a unit from your army is selected to fight, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by PENITENT models in that unit.

Death Before Disgrace

Each time a PENITENT model from your army is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 2+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Purity of Suffering
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, PENITENT models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

stratagems.name: Lash of Guilt
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before a PENITENT unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That PENITENT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the PENITENT ENGINES keyword, do not make an Advance roll for it; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Passion of the Penitent
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a PENITENT model in your unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Final Redemption
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Devout Fanaticism
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Boundless Zeal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the PENITENT keyword, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

detachments.name: Chorus of Condemnation
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY units have the following ability:
▪ **Condemnatory Psalms:** In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is condemned: while a unit is condemned, that unit has +3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Inspirational Battle Canticles
stratagems.when: Start of the Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY unit or one friendly EXORCIST unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTA SORORITAS unit within 6" of your unit. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Harmonised Exorcism
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EXORCIST unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That EXORCIST unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one unit **[gloss:visible:visible]** to and within 9" of a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have +1 to Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Devastating Reprise
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EXORCIST unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) hit by those ranged attacks. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

detachments.name: Sacred Champions
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly CELESTIAN units’ attacks have +1 BS and WS.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **REVEREND** tag and cannot be taken with another **REVEREND** **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Blows
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A and S.

stratagems.name: Faithful Fortitude
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
stratagems.target: That CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]** until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Unflinching Determination
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
▪ That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

detachments.name: Sanctified Orators
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Enhancements selected from this **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** do not count towards the total number of enhancements in your army.
▪ Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER units have +1 Ld.

armyRule.name: Martial Ka’tah
armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability are **[gloss:ac-readied:readied]**. While a friendly unit is **readied**, you can select one of the **[gloss:ac-katah-ability:ka’tah abilities]** presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer **readied**.

Each **ka’tah ability** will tell you when that **ka’tah ability** can be used, and the effects that **ka’tah ability** has on the unit using it.

We recommend placing a token next to each **readied** unit, removing it when that unit is no longer **readied**.

◈# Conversai
◈ WHEN | Your Command phase.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Until the end of the turn:
▪ Being **[gloss:engaged:engaged]/[gloss:battle-shocked:battle‑shocked]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.
▪ Starting an **[gloss:action:action]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

◈# Calistus
◈ WHEN | Your Movement phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.
◈ TARGET | That **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | When your unit makes a **[gloss:normal-move:normal]/[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]**, your unit can move through all types of model.

◈# Salvus
◈ WHEN | Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
◈ TARGET | That **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
▪ **[gloss:ballistic-skill:BS].**
▪ **[gloss:hit-roll:Hit rolls]** and **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

◈# Dacatarai
◈ WHEN | Start of the Fight phase.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can **[gloss:re-roll:re‑roll]** hit rolls of 1.

◈# Kaptaris
◈ WHEN | Start of the Fight phase.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to **hit rolls**.

◈# Rendax
◈ WHEN | Fight phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is** [gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured Ka'tah]**

Many of the most prominent shield hosts favour a specific martial ka’tah above all others.

All **[gloss:detachments:detachments]** tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these **detachments**, the **ka’tah ability** that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that **detachment** grants the additional effect listed in that **detachment**.

Example: If you selected the Solar Watch **detachment**, when you select the Calistus **ka’tah ability** for a **readied** unit, that unit has +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]** in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

### Aegis of the Emperor
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

### Aquila Commander
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Daughters of the Abyss
▪ Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have [core:Feel No Pain 3+] against **[gloss:psychic-attack:psychic attacks]**.
▪ Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability:

Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit have [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **psychic attacks**.

### Anathema Psykana
Though the Adeptus Custodes often fight alongside the Silent Sisterhood, they take orders only from their own commanders, or from the Emperor Himself.

You can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units in your army, even though they do not have the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated:
▪ You cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your **[gloss:army-faction:army faction]**.
▪ You cannot select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model to be your WARLORD.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make:
▪ **[gloss:shock-disembark-move:shock disembark move]** (18.07)

detachments.name: Dread Host
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units can re‑roll **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured ka’tah]**
◈# Dacatarai
◈ ADDITIONAL EFFECT | When an enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit makes a **[gloss:pile-in:pile‑in]/[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**, -2" from that **pile‑in/consolidation move**.

stratagems.name: Golden Light of the Moiraides
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES Unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
▪ Attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
▪ Enemy units cannot target your unit with **[gloss:snap-shooting:snap shooting]** attacks.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Rapidity
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit ends an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: That **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

stratagems.name: Lightning Wrath
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a **[gloss:pile-in:pile‑in move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: When making that **[gloss:pile-in:pile‑in move]**, your unit can move up to D3+3".

detachments.name: Auric Champions
detachments.ruleBody: In your Command phase, you can select one enemy unit to be a **[gloss:ac-dreadful-foe:dreadful foe]** unit until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER models’ attacks that target a **dreadful foe** unit have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model has used a (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use that (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability one additional time, but not in the same phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this **[gloss:stratagem:stratagem]** on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if that model is a CHARACTER model:
▪ On a 3+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

detachments.name: Aquilan Shield
detachments.ruleBody:
While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, ranged attacks that target that unit with a **[gloss:strength:S]** greater than that unit’s **[gloss:toughness:T]** have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured ka’tah]**
◈# Salvus
◈ ADDITIONAL EFFECT | Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" **[gloss:range:R]**.

stratagems.name: Rapid Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]**.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit that was **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using **[gloss:normal-shooting:normal shooting]**, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]/[gloss:declare-charge:declare a charge]**.

stratagems.name: Tip of the Talon
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of your unit have +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.

detachments.name: Emissaries Imperatus
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units have [core:Fights First].

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured Ka’tah]**

◈ ADDITIONAL EFFECT | Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.

stratagems.name: Bearers of His Light
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks can ignore modifiers to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** and **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Slayers of Nightmares
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a unit with a **[gloss:toughness:T]** greater than this unit’s **T** have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Selfless Service
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 6" of an enemy unit. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect:
**[gloss:declare-charge:Declare a charge]** with your unit:
▪ When making the **[gloss:charge-roll:charge roll]**, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
▪ When selecting **[gloss:charge-target:charge targets]**, you can select __any__ enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the **[gloss:maximum-distance:maximum distance]**.

detachments.name: Emperor’s Chosen
detachments.ruleBody:
When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to attack, that unit’s attacks can:
▪ Re‑roll __one__ **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]**.
▪ Re‑roll __one__ **[gloss:wound-roll:wound roll]**.

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured ka’tah]**
◈# Rendax
◈ ADDITIONAL EFFECT | You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit and roll one D6:
▪ On a 1‑2, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
▪ On a 3‑5, that enemy unit suffers D3 **mortal wounds**.
▪ On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 **mortal wounds**.

stratagems.name: In Auramite clad
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding CUSTODIAN WARDENS units).
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]** until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Impenetrable Bastion
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:objective:objective]** your unit is controlling. That **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**.

stratagems.name: Superhuman Focus
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not **[gloss:ac-readied:readied]**.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is **[gloss:ac-readied:readied]**.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this **[gloss:stratagem:stratagem]** more than once per battle round.

detachments.name: Solar Watch
detachments.ruleBody:
When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]**, that **fall‑back move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to charge**.

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured ka’tah]**
◈# Calistus
◈ ADDITIONAL EFFECT | Your unit has +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.

stratagems.name: Inexorable
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
▪ **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.
▪ **[gloss:advance-roll:Advance rolls]** and **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

stratagems.name: At Spear’s Length
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: That **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

stratagems.name: Gravimetric Grenade

stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**, that enemy unit has -1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

detachments.name: Might of the Moritoi
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is at **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]**, that unit has +2 **[gloss:objective-control:OC]**.
▪ While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below **starting strength**, that unit’s attacks can re‑roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is **[gloss:half-strength:below half‑strength]**, that unit’s attacks can:
▪ Re‑roll **hit rolls** of 1.
▪ Re‑roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.

stratagems.name: Unceasing Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit ends an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
▪ That move does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

stratagems.name: Honoured Interred
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit has the following ability:

**Honoured Interred (Aura):** Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit can re‑roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable momentum
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]** or **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

detachments.name: Grav‑Assault Force
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly GRAV‑ASSAULT units have 4+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]** against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Victory Before Death
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly GRAV‑ASSAULT unit within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]** is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**.
stratagems.target: That GRAV‑ASSAULT unit. You can target that unit with this **[gloss:stratagem:stratagem]** even though it is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**.
stratagems.effect:
Select one **[gloss:objective:objective]** that:
▪ Your unit was controlling when it was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**.
▪ Has no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) within range of it.

That **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**.

stratagems.name: Advanced Stabilisers

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV‑ASSAULT unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:

detachments.name: Honoured Companions
detachments.ruleBody: While a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, that unit’s attacks can re‑roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Domain

stratagems.effect:
You can select the **[gloss:objective-consolidation:objective consolidation mode]** for that **[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**, regardless of that **consolidation move**’s Before Moving restrictions.

This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen

stratagems.target: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks (excluding those made by CHARACTER models) have +2 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.

stratagems.target: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3".

detachments.name: Lions of the Emperor
detachments.ruleBody: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, you can place that unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending

stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 **[gloss:damage-roll:D]** until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions

stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that has 2+ models.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing __one__ model. These new units each have a **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]** of 1.

stratagems.name: Fury of the Emperor

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

detachments.name: Guardians of the Throne
detachments.ruleBody:
In the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**, that unit’s melee attacks have:

▪ __Or:__ [LETHAL HITS].

Your unit’s ranged attacks can:

detachments.name: Shadowkeepers

While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, melee attacks that target that unit with a **[gloss:strength:S]** greater than that unit’s **[gloss:toughness:T]** have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured ka’tah]**
◈# Kaptaris
◈ ADDITIONAL EFFECT | You can select one enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit. That enemy unit must make a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle‑shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle‑shock roll**. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER].

stratagems.name: No Escape

stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: **[gloss:declare-charge:Declare a charge]** with your unit. When selecting **[gloss:charge-target:charge targets]**, you can only select enemy units that made a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]** this phase and are within the **[gloss:maximum-distance:maximum distance]**.

stratagems.name: Indomitable Guardians
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]** and is **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]**.

detachments.name: Null Maiden Vigil
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ When mustering your army, you can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD.
▪ Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.
▪ Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have the following ability:

**Creeping Dread (Aura):** In the Battle‑shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]** makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle‑shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle‑shock roll**.

▪ Attacks that target a **prosecuted** unit have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.

armyRule.name: Doctrina Imperatives
armyRule.body:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Doctrina Imperatives below. Until the end of the battle round, that Doctrina Imperative is active for your army, and all units from your army that have the Doctrina Imperatives ability gain the relevant abilities shown below.

### Protector Imperative
▪ Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [HEAVY] ability.
▪ Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
▪ Each time a melee attack targets this unit, if this unit has the Battleline keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

### Conqueror Imperative
▪ Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
▪ Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
▪ Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the Battleline keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

detachments.name: Rad-Zone Corps
detachments.ruleBody:
### Bombardment
At the start of the first battle round, for each enemy unit within your opponent's deployment zone, your opponent must decide whether that unit will take cover or stand firm. You then roll one D6 for each of those enemy units and apply the relevant result below:
▪ **Unit Standing Firm:** On a 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
▪ **Unit Taking Cover:** That unit is **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]**. On a 5+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

### Fallout
At the start of your Command phase during the second, third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within your opponent's deployment zone. On a 3+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound and must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Baleful Halo
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks. If that unit is Battleline, you can also target one friendly Skitarii unit (excluding Battleline units) within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets one of those units from your army, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Pre-calibrated Purge Solution
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. If that unit is Battleline, you can also target one friendly Skitarii unit (excluding Battleline units) within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of those units makes a ranged attack, if the target of that attack is within your opponent's deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Extinction Order
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Tech-Priest model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of that model.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within range of that objective marker. On a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound and must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Lethal Dosage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Aggressor Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Skitarii unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase. If that unit is Battleline, you can also target one friendly Skitarii unit (excluding Battleline units) within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Bulwark Imperative
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Skitarii unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks. If that unit is Battleline, you can also target one friendly Skitarii unit (excluding Battleline units) within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in those units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.

detachments.name: Skitarii Hunter Cohort
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly SKITARII INFANTRY, SKITARII MOUNTED and IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII units have [core:Stealth].

stratagems.name: Bionic Endurance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Sicarian, Pteraxii or Sydonian unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: Isolate and Destroy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Sicarian, Pteraxii, Sydonian, Ironstrider Ballistarii or Skitarii Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other enemy units within 6" of the unit targeted by that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Binharic Offence
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two Skitarii units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in both of your units by 1.
stratagems.restrictions: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

stratagems.name: Shroud Protocols
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: Expedited Purge Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Skitarii unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Programmed Withdrawal
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Sicarian units from your army, or one SKITARII INFANTRY or Skitarii Mounted unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.restrictions: Each unit targeted with this Stratagem must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.

detachments.name: Data-Psalm Conclave
detachments.ruleBody:
At the start of the first battle round, select one of the following Benedictions of the Omnissiah to be active for Cult Mechanicus units from your army until the end of the battle:
▪ **Panegyric Procession:** Each time a Cult Mechanicus model from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within half range, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
▪ **Citation in Savagery:** Each time a Cult Mechanicus unit from your army is selected to fight, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

This detachment has the DATA-PSALM tag and cannot be taken with another DATA-PSALM detachment.

stratagems.name: Incantation of the Iron Soul
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after you allocate a mortal wound to a Cult Mechanicus model from your army.
stratagems.target: That Cult Mechanicus model's unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Cult Mechanicus models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Tribute of Emphatic Veneration
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Cult Mechanicus unit from your army and one enemy unit within 18" of it.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Chant of the Remorseless Fist
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Cult Mechanicus unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a Cult Mechanicus model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Litany of the Electromancer
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Cult Mechanicus unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of one or more Cult Mechanicus models in your unit, adding 1 to the result if that model is an Electro-Priest. On a 5+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Verse of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Cult Mechanicus unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a Cult Mechanicus model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Luminescent Blessing
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Cult Mechanicus unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Cult Mechanicus models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

detachments.name: Explorator Maniple
detachments.ruleBody: At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker. Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is your Acquisition objective marker. Each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model from your army makes an attack, if that model's unit is within range of your Acquisition objective marker, or if the target of that attack is within range of your Acquisition objective marker, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Cached Acquisition
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Auto-oracular Retrieval
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Acquisition objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Priority Reclamation
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within range of your Acquisition objective marker.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target a unit with this Stratagem if it is within 3" of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Incense Exhausts
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKE unit within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, both of those units have the Stealth ability and the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.name: Infoslave Skull
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Tech-Priest model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of that model (excluding your Acquisition objective marker).
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is also considered to be one of your Acquisition objective markers for all rules purposes.

stratagems.name: Reactive Safeguard
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army within range of your Acquisition objective marker that was selected as a target of that charge, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT.
stratagems.restrictions: Every model in your unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.

detachments.name: Cohort Cybernetica
detachments.ruleBody: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in Legio Cybernetica units from your army. In addition, unless that unit is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Motive Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: Auto-divinatory Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Legio Cybernetica or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army, and one objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+ and the [IGNORES COVER] ability, but they can only target units within range of the selected objective marker.

stratagems.name: Machine Spirit Resurgent
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Legio Cybernetica or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Machine Superiority
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Legio Cybernetica or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

stratagems.name: Transcendent Cogitation
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Legio Cybernetica or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for your unit.

stratagems.name: Benevolence of the Omnissiah
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Legio Cybernetica or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, which is improved to Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

detachments.name: Cohort Acquisitus
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly Pteraxii / Infiltrators / Rangers / Serberys Raiders / Serberys Sulphurhounds units have Recon Augury.
▪ Friendly Recon Augury units have the following ability:
▪ **Enhanced Augurs:** In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is analysed. While a unit is analysed, that unit has +3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Defect Scrutiny
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of a friendly Recon Augury unit. Your unit's ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Repolarised Augurs
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** Recon Augury unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Clandestine Reposition
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** Infiltrators / Pteraxii unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.

detachments.name: Lords of the Forge
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have:
▪ 4+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]**.
▪ [core:Feel No Pain 5+].

Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have the following ability:
▪ **Baffling Data Screed:** In your Shooting phase, when this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, if this unit is not **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]**, you can use this ability. If you do, roll one D6:
▪ On a 2+, select one enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**. A unit cannot be selected for this ability more than once per turn.
▪ __Or:__ On 2+, those ranged attacks do not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:hidden:hidden]**.

stratagems.name: Scriptural Prognosis
stratagems.when: In your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Tech-Priest unit that is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
stratagems.target: That Tech-Priest unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Overloaded Safeguards
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Tech-Priest unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.
stratagems.target: That Tech-Priest unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Holy Avarice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Tech-Priest unit **[gloss:action:starts an action]**.
stratagems.target: That Tech-Priest unit.
stratagems.effect: That **[gloss:action:action]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

detachments.name: Luminen Auto-choir
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly Corpuscarii units' ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
▪ When a friendly Fulgurite unit has fought, that unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** D3 wounds.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the DATA-PSALM tag and cannot be taken with another DATA-PSALM **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Echoes of the Conduit Wars
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Electro-Priests unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That Electro-Priests unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit's attacks that target a unit within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]** can:
▪ Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
▪ Re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Chant of Electrotraction
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Electro-Priests unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:Advance move]**.
stratagems.target: That Electro-Priests unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Momentum Feedback
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** Electro-Priests unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That Electro-Priests unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:Surge move]** of up to D6".

detachments.name: Eradication Cohort
detachments.ruleBody:
Each time a model in a Skitarii unit from your army makes an attack:
▪ If the Protector Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
▪ If the Conqueror Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Servo-driven Charge
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.name: Threat-cogitation Targeters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

stratagems.name: Unrelenting Aggression
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the Skitarii keyword, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

stratagems.name: Precision Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Sicarian unit from your army declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That Sicarian unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Unshackled Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Skitarii unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Analytic Reprisals
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Skitarii Infantry unit from your army that lost one or more models as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

detachments.name: Haloscreed Battle Clade
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Command phase, select one or more ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units from your army (including units that are embarked within TRANSPORTS). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
▪ **Incursion:** 1 unit
▪ **Strike Force:** 2 units
▪ **Onslaught:** 3 units

Until the start of your next Command phase, those units gain the Halo Override keyword. Then, select one of the Override abilities below. Until the start of your next Command phase, units from your army with the Halo Override keyword have the selected Override ability:
▪ **Electromotive Energisation:** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.
▪ **Microactuator Bracing:** Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in this unit.
▪ **Predation Protocols:** This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
▪ **Muted Servomotors:** Models in this unit have the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Eradication Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, and, if it is a Halo Override unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Targeting Override
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Neural Overload
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit is a Halo Override unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Select one Override ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active for your unit.

**Designer's Note:** This means that if the targeted unit already has the Halo Override keyword, it can be affected by multiple Override abilities at the same time, but suffers mortal wounds to do so. Alternatively, if your unit does not have the Halo Override keyword, it instead has the chosen Override ability until the start of your next Command phase, but does not benefit from any other Override abilities that are active.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Impulse
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Skorpius Dunerider model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Guided Retreat
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:Fall Back move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ If your unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, your unit can re-roll **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]**.
▪ That **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]** does not prevent your unit from:
▪ Being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.
▪ Being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

stratagems.name: Analytical Divination
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit (excluding Kataphron units) from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a Halo Override unit.

weapons.name: Rod of the War Forge – strike
Rod of the War Forge – sweep

armyRule.name: Battle Focus
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is **Asuryani**, at the start of the battle round, you receive a number of Battle Focus tokens based on the battle size, as shown below:
▪ **Incursion:** 2 Battle Focus tokens.
▪ **Strike Force:** 4 Battle Focus tokens.
▪ **Onslaught:** 6 Battle Focus tokens.

Each time one of the triggers shown in the Agile Manoeuvres section below occurs, you can spend one Battle Focus token to enable the relevant eligible unit to perform that Agile Manoeuvre. A unit is eligible to perform an Agile Manoeuvre if it has this ability and has not already performed an Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot trigger the same Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase. At the end of the battle round, all unspent Battle Focus tokens are lost.

### Swift as the Wind
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. You can trigger this Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase (provided a different unit performs it each time).
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

### Flitting Shadows
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at that unit.

### Star Engines
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to make an Advance move.
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

### Sudden Strike
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible unit from your army ends a charge move.
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

### Opportunity Seized
**TRIGGER:** When an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
**EFFECT:** One eligible unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

### Fade Back
**TRIGGER:** In your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
**EFFECT:** One eligible unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

**Disparate Paths:** When mustering your army, you can include Harlequins units in your army, even though they do not have the **Asuryani** Faction keyword. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot select Harlequins or Ynnari as your Army Faction.

detachments.name: Warhost
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ At the start of the battle round, you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.
▪ Each time a unit from your army performs the Swift as the Wind Agile Manoeuvre, until the end of the phase, add an additional 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
▪ Each time a unit from your army performs an Agile Manoeuvre that involves rolling a D6, add 1 to the result.

stratagems.name: Lightning-Fast Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Blitzing Firepower
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 12". If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Sanctuary
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

stratagems.name: Fire and Fade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT, ASURMEN and WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".
stratagems.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Feigned Retreat
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ASURYANI unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Webway Tunnel
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Windrider Host
detachments.ruleBody:
In the Declare Battle Formations step you can set up **Asuryani Mounted** and **Vyper** units from your army in Reserves. During the battle, such units can be set up on the battlefield as if they were arriving from Strategic Reserves. For the purposes of setting up **Asuryani Mounted** or **Vyper** units from your army on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

In addition, at the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of **Asuryani Mounted** or **Vyper** units from your army (excluding units within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), then remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size:
▪ **Incursion:** 1 unit.
▪ **Strike Force:** 2 units.
▪ **Onslaught:** 3 units.

stratagems.name: Death from on High
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield from Reserves this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Overflight
stratagems.when: End of your Shooting phase or the end of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 7".

stratagems.name: Wind of Blades
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Daring Riders
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield from Reserves, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. When doing so, if your unit is set up within 8" horizontally of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Focused Firepower
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Spiralling Evasion
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

detachments.name: Spirit Conclave
detachments.ruleBody:
Each time an **Asuryani Psyker** model from your army is destroyed by an enemy unit, that enemy unit gains a Vengeful Dead token. Each time a **Wraith Construct** model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit with one or more Vengeful Dead tokens, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Asuryani Psyker models from your army have the following ability:
