▪ **Spirit Guides (Aura):** While a Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit from your army is within 12" of this model, that unit has the Battle Focus ability.

stratagems.name: Seer's Eye
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI PSYKER model from your army and one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of it that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your PSYKER model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your Wraith Construct unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Armour Penetration and/or Damage characteristics of that attack.

stratagems.name: Wraithbone Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Wraith Construct unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Blades from Beyond
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Soul Bridge
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit from your army and one ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit is considered to be within 12" of your PSYKER model for the purposes of the Psychic Guidance and Spirit Guides abilities.

stratagems.name: Spirit Token
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Wraithblades or Wraithguard unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Crushing Strides
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each Wraithblades model in your unit, or roll four D6 if your unit has the Wraithlord keyword, or roll six D6 if your unit has the Wraithknight keyword: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

detachments.name: Guardian Battlehost
detachments.ruleBody: Each time a **Dire Avenger**, **Guardian**, **Support Weapon** or **War Walker** model from your army makes an attack, if that model's unit and/or the target unit are within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Warding Salvoes
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Shield Nodes
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Vaul's Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army.
stratagems.target: One WAR WALKERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Time to Strike
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Storm Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Blades of Asuryan
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

stratagems.name: Cost of Victory
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Guardians unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. When doing so, return every destroyed Guardians model to your unit.

detachments.name: Ghosts of the Webway
detachments.ruleBody: Each time a **Harlequins** model from your army makes a Charge move, it can move through enemy models.

stratagems.name: Staged Death
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
stratagems.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: Heroes' Fall
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Mocking Flight
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HARLEQUINS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Tricksters' Retort
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Troupe unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Bloody Dance
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
stratagems.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.name: Exit the Stage
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Devoted of Ynnead
detachments.ruleBody:
You can use the following rules:

### Lethal Intent
At the end of your opponent's Shooting phase, if one or more **Ynnari** units from your army were destroyed this phase, select one **Ynnari Infantry** or **Ynnari Mounted** unit from your army that was within 6" of your destroyed unit. That unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D6+1".

### Lethal Surge
Once per turn, when a **Ynnari** unit from your army performs the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre, it can make a surge move of up to D6+1" instead of a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]**.

### Lethal Reprisal
At the start of the Fight phase, select one **Ynnari** unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that is below its Starting Strength. Until the end of the phase, that unit has the Fights First ability.

**Servants of the Whispering God:**
▪ You can include **Ynnari** units in your army, even though they do not have the **Asuryani** Faction keyword.
▪ **Asuryani** units (excluding **Epic Heroes**) from your army gain the **Ynnari** keyword.
▪ You must include Yvraine and/or The Yncarne in your army, and one of those models must be your **[gloss:warlord:Warlord]**.

stratagems.name: Pall of Dread
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Macabre Resilience
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI INFANTRY or YNNARI MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Emissaries of Ynnead
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a YNNARI INFANTRY unit from your army has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: That YNNARI INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: Parting the Veil
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Soulsight
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.name: Death Answers Death
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units), if one or more models in that unit were destroyed this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase.

detachments.name: Seer Council
detachments.ruleBody:
At the start of the first battle round, you generate Fate dice by rolling a number of D6 based on the battle size, as shown below. Keep your Fate dice to one side — this is your Fate dice pool.
▪ **Incursion:** 3 D6.
▪ **Strike Force:** 6 D6.
▪ **Onslaught:** 9 D6.

Each time you use one of the Stratagems opposite, if your Fate dice pool contains one or more Fate dice showing the corresponding value in the table below, you can discard one of those corresponding Fate dice. If you do, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP:
▪ **Presentiment of Dread** — Fate dice value **1**.
▪ **Forewarned** — Fate dice value **2**.
▪ **Unshrouded Truth** — Fate dice value **3**.
▪ **Fate Inescapable** — Fate dice value **4**.
▪ **Isha's Fury** — Fate dice value **5**.
▪ **Psychic Shield** — Fate dice value **6**.

stratagems.name: Presentiment of Dread
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to your model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Forewarned
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Unshrouded Truth
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to move this phase, was not set up on the battlefield this phase, and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.
▪ Your unit has [core:Deep Strike].
▪ Your unit must make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]** this phase (including in your first turn).
stratagems.restrictions: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to be selected to move.

stratagems.name: Fate Inescapable
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Isha's Fury
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Psychic Shield
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

detachments.name: Aspect Host
detachments.ruleBody:
Each time an **Aspect Warriors** or **Avatar of Khaine** unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, select one of the following abilities for it to gain until the end of the phase:
▪ Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
▪ Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Warrior Focus
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: To Their Final Breath
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Sanctuary
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

stratagems.name: Doom Inescapable
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Avatar of Khaine model from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model's Wailing Doom ranged weapon has a Range characteristic of 18" and a Damage characteristic of 8.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Precision
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, select one of the following abilities, or select two of the following abilities if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem: [IGNORES COVER], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected abilities.

stratagems.name: Khaine's Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: All models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

detachments.name: Armoured Warhost
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly AELDARI VEHICLE units' ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: Layered Wards
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
stratagems.target: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

stratagems.name: Soulsight
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit's attacks can re-roll:
▪ One Hit roll.
▪ One Wound roll.
▪ One **[gloss:damage-roll:Damage roll]**.

stratagems.name: Vectored Engines
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit makes a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

detachments.name: Fateful Performance
detachments.ruleBody: While a friendly **HARLEQUINS** unit is making a **[gloss:charge-move:Charge move]**, that unit can move through enemy models.

stratagems.name: Heroes' Fall
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.effect: When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Exit the Stage
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.

stratagems.name: Deceptive Feint
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".

detachments.name: Path of the Outcast
detachments.ruleBody: When a friendly **RANGERS**/**SHROUD RUNNERS** unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, enemy units have +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until that friendly unit has shot.

stratagems.name: Eldritch Suppression
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll if a model in that enemy unit was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** by those attacks.

stratagems.name: Casting Back the Veil
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Nomads of the Hidden Way
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D6".
▪ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

detachments.name: Twilight Flickers
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly **HARLEQUINS** units have [core:Stealth].

stratagems.name: Presaged Rehearsal
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TROUPE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That TROUPE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: Captivating Performance
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly TROUPE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Phantasmal Mirage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D6".
▪ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

detachments.name: Serpent's Brood
detachments.ruleBody:
Weapons equipped by **Harlequins Mounted** and **Harlequins Vehicle** models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Each time a **Harlequins** unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, that unit's weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Fangs of the Brood
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Troupe unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit's Dance of Death ability, you can select three of the abilities for your unit to gain, instead of one.

stratagems.name: Venomous Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: After your unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Striking Stride
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Weaver’s Coils
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Weaving Stride
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Skyward Lunge
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Eldritch Raiders
detachments.ruleBody:
**Aeldari** units in your army are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced. In addition, each time an **Anhrathe**, **Rangers** or **Shroud Runners** unit from your army Advances, you can re-roll the Advance roll.

**Veterans of the Void:** Each time you add an **Anhrathe** unit to your army, it can be given up to one Corsair Enhancement (see below). Each Corsair Enhancement included in your army must be unique. If a unit is given a Corsair Enhancement, you must increase the points cost of that unit by the amount shown (see Munitorum Field Manual). If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.

stratagems.name: Raider’s Spoils
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Ruthless Killers
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Corsair Voidscarred unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or Fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Yriel's Example
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: No Prey Too Big
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe, Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Impeding Fire
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Rangers, Shroud Runners or Starfang unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) visible to and within 36" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

stratagems.name: Withdraw and Reinforce
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If that unit is below Starting Strength, return all destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.

detachments.name: Corsair Coterie
detachments.ruleBody:
While an objective marker is under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

**Anhrathe** units from your army have the following ability:
▪ **Void Thieves:** At the end of a phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

**Veterans of the Void:** Each time you add an **Anhrathe** unit to your army, it can be given up to one Corsair Enhancement (see below). Each Corsair Enhancement included in your army must be unique. If a unit is given a Corsair Enhancement, you must increase the points cost of that unit by the amount shown (see Munitorum Field Manual). If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.

stratagems.name: Pirates' Due
stratagems.when: The Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit has the Anhrathe keyword, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Lethal Ruse
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an AELDARI unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That AELDARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If it is an Anhrathe unit, also select one enemy unit your unit was within Engagement Range of at the start of the phase, and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Outcast Ambush
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] and [RAPID FIRE 1] abilities, and until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: Into the Breach
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Anhrathe unit from your army destroyed one or more enemy units.
stratagems.target: That Anhrathe unit.
stratagems.effect: After your unit has resolved all of its shooting attacks, it can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

stratagems.name: Cloak and Shadow
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker that you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability and your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: Vengeful Sorrow
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army, if one or more models in that unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, and if that Aeldari unit is neither Battle-shocked nor within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

weapons.name: The Staff of Ulthamar and witchblade

armyRule.name: Voice of Command
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is **ASTRA MILITARUM**, **OFFICER** models with this ability can issue [gloss:am-order:**Orders**]. Each **OFFICER**'s datasheet will specify how many **Orders** it can issue in a battle round and which units are eligible to receive those **Orders**. Each time an **Officer** model issues an **Order**, select one of the **Orders** below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **Officer** model to issue it to.

**OFFICER** models can issue **Orders** in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a TRANSPORT or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that **Order**. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one **Order** at a time (any **Order** subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). **Orders** cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an **Order** becomes Battle-shocked, that **Order** ceases to affect that unit. Only **ASTRA MILITARUM** models gain the benefit of an **Order** issued to their unit.

### The Orders
▪ **Move! Move! Move!** — Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.
▪ **Fix Bayonets!** — Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
▪ **Take Aim!** — Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
▪ **First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire!** — Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
▪ **Take Cover!** — Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model's Save to better than 3+).
▪ **Duty and Honour!** — Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

detachments.name: Armoured Infantry
detachments.ruleBody:
Add Squadron to the list of units each **Officer** unit from your army can issue [gloss:am-order:**Orders**] to. Add the **Order** below to those listed in the Voice of Command ability.

ON MY SIGNAL

This **Order** can only be issued to Armoured Skirmisher units (see Keywords). Each time an enemy unit ends a Normal or Advance move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". Each unit can only move in this way once per turn.

stratagems.name: Opening Salvo
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Order the Advance
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one or more friendly **ASTRA MILITARUM** units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.

stratagems.name: Supporting Ordnance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Combined Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.

stratagems.name: Mobile Firebase
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Burst of Speed
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

detachments.name: Combined Arms
detachments.ruleBody:
Each time a model in a Regiment unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Each time a model in a Squadron unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Action
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, [gloss:am-order:**Orders**] affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.

stratagems.name: Fields of Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Stalwart Protector
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

stratagems.name: Inspired Command
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your **OFFICER** can issue one **[gloss:am-order:Order]** as if it were your Command phase.

stratagems.name: Reinforcements!
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY Regiment unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
stratagems.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: Flexible Command
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue **[gloss:am-order:Orders]** to Regiment units and Squadron units.

detachments.name: Grizzled Company
detachments.ruleBody:
Add 1 to the number of [gloss:am-order:**Orders**] each ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER model from your army can issue, as stated on their datasheet.

While an **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army is affected by an **Order**, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Snap to It
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s **OFFICER** model can issue 1 **[gloss:am-order:Order]** as if it were your Command phase.

stratagems.name: Veteran Sharpshooters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: No Retreat!
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! **[gloss:am-order:Order]**.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Purging Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army affected by an **[gloss:am-order:Order]** that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Mordian Minute
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! **[gloss:am-order:Order]**.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Additional Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

detachments.name: Hammer of the Emperor
detachments.ruleBody: Each time a Squadron unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and when making that Advance move, that unit can move within Engagement Range of enemy models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of enemy models.

stratagems.name: Furious Cannonade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Squadron unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Blazing Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Final Hour
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Squadron unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding **Officer** units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Tactical Withdrawal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Crash Through
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: Ablative Plating
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

detachments.name: Mechanised Assault
detachments.ruleBody: Each time an **ASTRA MILITARUM** model from your army makes a ranged attack in a turn in which it disembarked from a TRANSPORT, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Clear and Secure
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Swift Interception
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One TRANSPORT unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Hasty Extraction
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Rapid Dispersal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Move Out
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s turn.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Vox-Relay
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY OFFICER unit from your army embarked within a Transport. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue [gloss:am-order:**Orders**] even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue **Orders** to ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT units from your army [excluding TITANIC units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit’s TRANSPORT.

detachments.name: Recon Element
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have [core:Stealth].

stratagems.name: Scouting Outriders
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s turn.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED or ASTRA MILITARUM WALKER unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Crack Shots
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Draw Them Out
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Platoon unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Courageous Diversion
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Scramble Field
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Reinforcements step.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.

stratagems.name: Tanglefoot Grenades
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to Charge rolls.

detachments.name: Siege Regiment
detachments.ruleBody:
At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support.
▪ **Creeping Barrage:** Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size, as shown below.
▪ **Incendiary Bombardment:** Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.
▪ **Smoke Shells:** Select a number of units from your army. Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

MAXIMUM NUMBER OF UNITS
▪ **Incursion:** 2
▪ **Strike Force:** 3
▪ **Onslaught:** 4

stratagems.name: Trench Fighters
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a Regiment model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Callous Sacrifice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Platoon unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

stratagems.name: Furious Fusillade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.

stratagems.name: Over the Top
stratagems.when: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY OFFICER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! [gloss:am-order:**Order**], it can issue that **Order** to any number of eligible friendly INFANTRY REGIMENT units, regardless of range to your model.

stratagems.name: Flare Burst
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Minefield
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Platoon unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

detachments.name: Steel Hammer
detachments.ruleBody: Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC or ASTRA MILITARUM SQUADRON unit from your army is selected to shoot, models in that unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of that unit (including with Blast weapons), provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. When doing so, such models do not suffer the penalty to their Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units (excluding attacks made with Indirect Fire weapons).

stratagems.name: Accuracy Under Pressure
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Engine of Wrath
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2, and each time a model in your unit fights, it can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Withering Firepower
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Shattering Salvo
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.name: Adamantine Behemoth
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Imposing Arrival
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit on the battlefield, wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

detachments.name: Abhuman Auxiliaries
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD/RATLINGS units have **ABHUMAN**.
▪ Friendly COMMISSAR models can:
▪ Issue the Take Aim! [gloss:am-order:**Order**].
▪ Issue 1 **Order** to a friendly ABHUMAN unit.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **ABHUMAN** tag and cannot be taken with another **ABHUMAN** **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Thick-skulled Obdurance
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit that is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
stratagems.target: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Low Profile
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RATLINGS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That RATLINGS unit.
stratagems.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:hidden:hidden]**.

stratagems.name: Stirred to Action
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

detachments.name: Bridgehead Strike
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ If a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS **OFFICER** model is your WARLORD, friendly TEMPESTUS SCIONS units have BATTLELINE and +1 OC.
▪ When a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, if that unit was set up this turn, that unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: On My Position
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly engaged REGIMENT unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit: on a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**. Then, your unit suffers 3D3 **mortal wounds**.

stratagems.name: Firing Hot
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Hot-shot Lascarbines, Hot-shot Lasguns, Hot-shot Laspistols, Hot-shot Marksman Rifles, Hot-shot Volley Guns and Sentry Hot-shot Volley Guns weapons that targeted an enemy unit within 12" have +1 S and AP.

stratagems.name: Servo-Designators
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

detachments.name: Designation Force
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE units have the following ability:
▪ **Signal Flares:** In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is designated: while a unit is designated, that unit has +3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **RECON** tag and cannot be taken with another **RECON** **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Close-range Detection
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: While a **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Triggered Alerts
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Sump-smog Screen
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.
stratagems.effect: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not **[gloss:fully-visible:fully visible]** to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the **[gloss:benefit-of-cover:Benefit of Cover]** against that attack.

units.name: Ciaphas Cain
abilityNames: Unparalleled Luck (Once per battle, per army)

units.name: ‘Iron Hand’ Straken
abilityNames: Been There, Seen it, Killed it

armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

### Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

### Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

### Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]** and **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** once per battle.
▪ Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

### Transhuman Strategist
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Heirs of Sigismund
▫ Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models.
▫ Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: GLADIATOR LANCER; GLADIATOR REAPER; GLADIATOR VALIANT; IMPULSOR; REPULSOR; REPULSOR EXECUTIONER.

detachments.name: Vow-sworn Crusaders
detachments.ruleBody:
At the start of the first battle round, you can select one **Vow** listed below. That **Vow** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until the end of the battle.

### Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
This unit’s melee attacks that target a **[gloss:psyker:PSYKER]** unit:
▪ Have [PRECISION].
▪ Have [LANCE].

### Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
Friendly melee attacks that target a unit with a **[gloss:toughness:T]** greater than this unit’s **[gloss:strength:S]** have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

### Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
Friendly INFANTRY units have:
▪ At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, that **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**.
▪ When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Pious Enmity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ __Or:__ Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll **hit rolls** of 1 and **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.

stratagems.name: Heresy Begets Retribution
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6”.

stratagems.name: For the Emperor's Honour!
stratagems.when: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Dread Crusaders
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects **[gloss:charge-target:charge targets]**.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was selected as a **[gloss:charge-target:charge target]** by that enemy unit this phase.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must make a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.

stratagems.name: Devout Push
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a **[gloss:pile-in:pile-in]/[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: When making that **[gloss:pile-in:pile-in]/[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**, your unit can move up to D3+3”.

stratagems.name: Spoor of the Unholy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
▪ **[gloss:ballistic-skill:BS]** and **[gloss:weapon-skill:WS]**.
▪ **[gloss:hit-roll:Hit rolls]**.

detachments.name: Marshal's Household
detachments.ruleBody:
In the Fight phase, if a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, that unit’s melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Blade of Detestation
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.
stratagems.target: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit **engaged** with that enemy unit:
▪ For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]** (to a maximum of 6 **mortal wounds**).

stratagems.name: Slayers of Abominations
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 **[gloss:strength:S]**.

stratagems.name: Unsparing Execution
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if that unit is **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that enemy unit must use the **[gloss:desperate-escape:desperate escape]** mode, with -1 to those **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]** if that enemy unit is **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**.

detachments.name: Fist of the God-Emperor
detachments.ruleBody:
Each time a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]**, instead of selecting a **[gloss:surge-target:surge target]**, you can select the closest **[gloss:objective:objective]** to that unit. When that unit makes that **surge move**, each model in that unit must end that **surge move** as close as possible to that **objective** instead.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Angels Defiant
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a **[gloss:strength:S]** greater than your unit’s **[gloss:toughness:T]** have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Avowed Destruction
stratagems.when: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks:
▪ Have [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Doctrinal Flexibility
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]**. That **combat doctrine** is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

units.name: Crusade Ancient
abilityNames: Martial Honour (Once per battle, per unit)

weapons.name: Sword of the High Marshals – strike
Sword of the High Marshals – sweep

armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

### Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

### Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

### Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]** and **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** once per battle.
▪ Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

### Transhuman Strategist
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1**[gloss:command-points:CP]**.

detachments.name: Wrath of the Doomed
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following:
▪ At the start of each phase, the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** is active for this unit.
▪ The **devastator/tactical doctrine** __cannot__ be active for this unit.

This means that, regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the **assault doctrine**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: No Barrier to Retribution
stratagems.when: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal]/[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Rage-fuelled Response
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Death Begets Vengeance
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** by an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
That enemy unit is **hated** until the end of the battle:
▪ While a unit is **hated**, friendly DEATH COMPANY units' attacks that target that unit have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

detachments.name: Encarmine Speartip
detachments.ruleBody:
The **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:tactical doctrine]** is active for SANGUINARY GUARD units __in addition__ to any other **combat doctrine**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Judgement of the Golden Host
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit form your army ends a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit **engaged** with that enemy unit:
▪ For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

stratagems.name: Inexorable Valour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Blinding Blurs of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit has:
▪ [core:Stealth].
▪ -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

detachments.name: Angelic Inheritors
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units:
▪ Can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ Can re-roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Focused Fury
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks:
▪ Have [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is a CHARACTER unit, have [LETHAL HITS], [LANCE].

stratagems.name: Instant of Grace
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
