armyRule.name: Cult Ambush
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below:
▪ **Incursion:** 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Strike Force:** 10 Resurgence points.
▪ **Onslaught:** 14 Resurgence points.

Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model (excluding CHARACTER models) in that unit has this ability, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit's Starting Strength (not including attached CHARACTER models):
▪ **Aberrants:** 5 models — 4 Resurgence points; 10 models — 8 Resurgence points.
▪ **Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, Hybrid Metamorphs:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 4 Resurgence points.
▪ **Atalan Jackals:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Neophyte Hybrids:** 10 models — 3 Resurgence points; 20 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Purestrain Genestealers:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.

If you do:
▪ Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit (excluding CHARACTER models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
▪ Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed).

### Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn. Units in Cult Ambush are not automatically destroyed at the end of the third battle round.

### Cult Ambush Markers
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush to make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**. For that **ingress move**, set that unit up with at least one model in that unit in base contact with that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield). Units in Cult Ambush can make an **ingress move** in the first battle round using this rule.

detachments.name: Biosanctic Broodsurge
detachments.ruleBody: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS and PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units from your army. In addition, each time such a unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Stimulated Bio-Surge
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Gene-Twisted Muscle
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Hyper-Metabolic Vigour
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Saintly Paroxysm
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.target: That destroyed CHARACTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If that CHARACTER model is an Abominant or Patriarch, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead.

stratagems.name: Bio-Horror Revelation
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit within 9" of your unit is selected to shoot, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result. If that test is failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Evasive Vanguard
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

detachments.name: Brood Brothers Auxilia
detachments.ruleBody:
### Integrated Tactics
Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (see below) is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to that unit. If you do, until the end of the phase, models in that ASTRA MILITARUM unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and that enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire. While an enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire, each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model from your army targets that enemy unit with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

### BROOD BROTHERS
You can include ASTRA MILITARUM units in your army, even though they do not have the GENESTEALER CULTS Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:
▪ Incursion: Up to 500 pts
▪ Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts
▪ Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts
A GENESTEALER CULTS model must be your WARLORD, and ASTRA MILITARUM models from your army lose the Voice of Command ability if they have it. You cannot include units with any of the following keywords in your army using this rule: AIRCRAFT; COMMISSAR; EPIC HERO; MILITARUM TEMPESTUS; OGRYN; RATLING; TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER; MINISTORUM PRIEST.

stratagems.name: Symbiotic Destruction
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM and one GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to both of those selected units and within range of at least one ranged weapon from each of those units. Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, each time such a model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: A Dark Network
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM or GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Acceptable Losses
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those GENESTEALER CULTS units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Suppress and Overwhelm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem and each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army selects that enemy unit as a target of a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

stratagems.name: Regimental Reinforcements
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army (excluding Artillery and CHARACTER units) is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 3+, place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed) and add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Iron
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers. You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.

detachments.name: Final Day
detachments.ruleBody:
At the end of your Movement phase, for each TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army, you can select one friendly Genestealer Cults unit (excluding Purestrain Genestealer and Patriarch units) and one friendly Tyranids unit each within 9" of and visible to that SYNAPSE unit. If you do, that GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army suffers D3+1 mortal wounds and one model in the selected TYRANIDS unit regains up to that many lost wounds and until the start of your next Movement phase, each time a model in the selected TYRANIDS unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

TYRANIDS units from your army have the following ability:

**Catalyst (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Divine Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of a friendly engaged TYRANIDS unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.
stratagems.target: That GENESTEALER CULTS unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ You can use this part of this **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**. If you do:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **Charge rolls**.
▪ Your unit __must__ end that **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that friendly TYRANIDS unit.

stratagems.name: Hyperferocity
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly TYRANIDS units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Star Children
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS CHARACTER unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Darting Attacks
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Psi Surge
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit’s Catalyst ability by 3.
stratagems.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.

stratagems.name: Resistance Tunnels
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS or TYRANIDS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Host of Ascension
detachments.ruleBody: Each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Trap
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Primed and Readied
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: Tunnel Crawlers
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: Return to the Shadows
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Lying in Wait
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: A Deadly Snare
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

detachments.name: Outlander Claw
detachments.ruleBody: While a GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED/VEHICLE model from your army is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to its **[gloss:objective:Objective]** Control characteristic. In addition, at the end of your Command phase, if one or more Atalan Jackals units from your army are within range of an **objective** you control, that **objective** remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that **objective** marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Devoted Crew
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Deft Manoeuvring
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Close-Range Shoot-Out
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".

stratagems.name: Along Shadowed Trails
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Rapid Feint
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Encircling the Prey
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Xenocreed Congregation
detachments.ruleBody: For each ACOLYTE HybRIDS, HybRID METAMORPHS and NEOPHYTE HybRIDS unit from your army, while one or more CHARACTER models are leading that unit, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for it. If that CHARACTER model is a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD, that model has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability while leading that unit.

stratagems.name: Frenzied Devotion
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding CHARACTERS) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.name: Vengeance for the Martyr!
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.target: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: The Downtrodden Rise
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Transcendent Celerity
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: Tireless Fervour
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect:
▪ If your unit made an advance/**[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]** this turn, that advance/**fall-back move** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.
▪ When your unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**, you can use this part of this **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**. If you do:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ Your unit __must__ end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit engaged with a friendly CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.name: The Path of Anguish
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

detachments.name: Heroes of the Uprising
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly KELERMORPH/LOCUS/REDUCTUS SABOTEUR/SANCTUS models have KILLER.
▪ Friendly KILLER models’ attacks can:
▪ Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
▪ Re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Living Up to Legend
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit has attacked, if those attacks **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** an enemy unit or an enemy CHARACTER model.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect: Each **[gloss:visible:visible]** friendly **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]** GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of your unit is no longer **Battle-shocked**.

stratagems.name: Surging Broodworship
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks made by KILLER models in your unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

stratagems.name: Loyal to the End
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly KILLER unit.
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a KILLER model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6:
▪ On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
▪ On a 2+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

detachments.name: Purestrain Broodswarm
detachments.ruleBody: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** PURESTRAIN GENESTEALER units can be placed in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.

stratagems.name: Lurk and Strike
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Crawling Horror
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has -6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Inhuman Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".

detachments.name: Xenocult Masses
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Command phase, if a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**, that unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** 3 wounds.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **HOSTS** tag and cannot be taken with another **HOSTS** **detachment**.

stratagems.name: Eyes of the Cult
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**.
stratagems.effect: Enemy units within that **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]** have +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

stratagems.name: Fanatical Hail
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can re-roll Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Slunk from the Underbelly
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit with every model within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**.
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that unit has attacked.

enhancements.name: Deeds That Speak to the Masses

units.name: Neophyte Hybrids
abilityNames: A Plan Generations in the Making

armyRule.name: Gate of Infinity
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is GREY KNIGHTS, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, you can select a number of units (see below) from your army that are on the battlefield (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), provided every model in those units has this ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
▪ **Incursion:** Up to 2 units.
▪ **Strike Force:** Up to 3 units.
▪ **Onslaught:** Up to 4 units.

▪ Place those units in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.
▪ Those units can make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]** in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

detachments.name: Augurium Task Force
detachments.ruleBody:
From the second battle round onwards, at the start of your Movement phase, if you did not select the maximum number of Grey Knights units from your army using the Gate of Infinity ability at the end of your opponent’s previous turn, you can select one GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is on the battlefield that could have been selected using the Gate of Infinity ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

**Designer’s Note:** This means that your unit can retain its position on the battlefield at the end of your Command phase, and then be placed into Strategic Reserves at the start of your Movement phase, to set it up again in your Reinforcements step in another position.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Anticipation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Appointed Hour
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Forewarned Evasion
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS WALKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Necessary End
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Redirected Strike
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

**Designer’s Note:** This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.

stratagems.name: Mirage of Echoes
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Banishers
detachments.ruleBody:
Each time a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army is selected to fight, that unit can take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, select one of the following rules. Until the end of the phase, that unit has that rule.
▪ Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
▪ Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [PSYCHIC] ability also have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Hexwrought Reprisal
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

stratagems.name: Warding Chant
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.

stratagems.name: Chaos Bane
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.

stratagems.name: Celerity
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Shadow of Anarch
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Circle of Sanctuary
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.

detachments.name: Brotherhood Strike
detachments.ruleBody: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Purgation Pattern
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Shining Veil
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Combat Manifestation
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Channelling
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Duty Unending
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GREY KNIGHTS units from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Expeditious Exit
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

**Designer’s Note:** This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

detachments.name: Hallowed Conclave
detachments.ruleBody: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Giants of the Battlefield
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Grind Them Underfoot
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: Unending Fidelity
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Shining Resolve
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Precognitive Strategies
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Purgation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.

detachments.name: Sanctic Spearhead
detachments.ruleBody: Each time a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: Abominus-Class Targets
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Will
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Argent Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: Force Wave
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Redoubled Assault
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Armoured Aegis
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

detachments.name: Warpbane Task Force
detachments.ruleBody:
Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army’s Hallowed Ground, as follows:
▪ Your deployment zone is always within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
▪ The area of the battlefield within 6" of one or more Purifier Squad units from your army is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
▪ At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man’s Land, until the end of that phase, No Man’s Land is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
▪ At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent’s deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent’s deployment zone is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
Each time a model in a GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible target or makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD and/or is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Kill Zone
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a Purifier Squad.

stratagems.name: Hallowed Beacon
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding Terminator units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Fires of Covenant
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Aegis Eternal
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Repelling Sphere
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

stratagems.name: Flames of Sanctity
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Purifier Squad unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes Castellan Crowe: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

detachments.name: Argent Assault
detachments.ruleBody: When a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**, if the S of those attacks is lower than the T of the target, those attacks have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Aegis
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 4+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

stratagems.name: A Threat Ended
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Aura of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit’s melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].

detachments.name: Fires of Purgation
detachments.ruleBody: When you select a unit to be **[gloss:pinned:pinned]** by a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit’s Righteous Persecution ability, that enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: Soul-locked
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Focused Immolation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have:
▪ [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
▪ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Spiritsear
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one Battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

detachments.name: Immaterial Interdiction
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do:
▪ That unit cannot use its Personal Teleporters ability.
▪ That unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6+1".

stratagems.name: Blades from the Beyond
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a **[gloss:charge-move:Charge move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: By Thought Alone
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit **[gloss:action:starts an Action]**.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: That **[gloss:action:Action]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

stratagems.name: Responsive Displacement
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a fall-back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.
stratagems.target: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".

units.name: Castellan Crowe
abilityNames: Champion of the Order of Purifiers (Psychic)

armyRule.name: Assigned Agents
armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this publication as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size:
▪ **Incursion:** 1 Retinue unit, 1 Character unit, 1 Requisitioned unit.
▪ **Strike Force:** 2 Retinue units, 2 Character units, 1 Requisitioned unit.
▪ **Onslaught:** 3 Retinue units, 3 Character units, 2 Requisitioned units.

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

detachments.name: Imperialis Fleet
detachments.ruleBody:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the following to apply:
Eliminate At All Costs

Select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Acquire At All Costs

Select one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, while an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army is within range of that objective marker, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1 and models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Close-Quarters Barrage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One VOIDFARERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Masters of the Void
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One VOIDFARERS CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this turn can be set up within your opponent’s deployment zone (all other restrictions still apply).

stratagems.name: Selfless Bodyguard
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM Attached unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack with the [PRECISION] ability is allocated to a CHARACTER model in your unit, if there are one or more Bodyguard models in your unit, roll one D6: on a 2+, that attack is allocated to a Bodyguard model of your choice in your unit instead.

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Will
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Violent Acquisition
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LANCE] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.name: Displacer Field
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save and, after the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, unless your unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" (when doing so, models in this unit move as if they have the FLY keyword).

detachments.name: Ordo Hereticus, Purgation Force
detachments.ruleBody:
Ranged weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS and ORDO HERETICUS models from your army have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Each time an ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS model from your army makes an attack that targets a CHAOS unit containing 5 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Dispense Justice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Execution Order
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy CHARACTER unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit targets that CHARACTER unit, its weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Inviolate Jurisdiction
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army within range of an objective marker and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: Exact Punishment
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army is destroyed as the result of an enemy unit's attacks.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that was within 6" of the destroyed unit (you cannot target the destroyed unit with the Stratagem).
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

stratagems.name: Line of Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can target enemy units that are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units with ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons), provided the target is within 12".

stratagems.name: Stun Grenades
stratagems.when: Start of any phase (excluding the Command phase).
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS or VEHICLES) within 8" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

detachments.name: Ordo Malleus, Daemon Hunters
detachments.ruleBody: Each time an INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and, if the target of that attack is a DAEMON unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Steel Heart
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Rites of Exorcism
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy DAEMON unit within 12" and visible to your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, then until the end of the phase, each time a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit makes an attack that targets that DAEMON unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Ritual of Warding
stratagems.when: Start of any Command phase.
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker is said to be Warded and remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While an objective marker is Warded and under your control, enemy DAEMON units cannot be set up on the battlefield within 6" of it.

stratagems.name: Hexagrammic Wards
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.name: Psybolt Ammunition
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC] abilities.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

detachments.name: Ordo Xenos, Alien Hunters
detachments.ruleBody:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Mission Tactics listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Mission Tactic is active and its effects apply to all DEATHWATCH units from your army. Each Mission Tactic can only be selected once per battle.
Furor Tactics

While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Malleus Tactics

While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units from your army have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Purgatus Tactics

While this Mission Tactic is active, each time a DEATHWATCH model from your army makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Tactics
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select the Furor Tactics, Malleus Tactics or Purgatus Tactics. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Deathwatch Mission Tactic is active for your unit instead of any other Deathwatch Mission Tactic that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Deathwatch Mission Tactic this battle.

stratagems.name: Rapid Tactical Relocation
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR or DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy models.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Dragonfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.name: Kraken Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve the Range characteristic of those weapons by 6".
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Dragonfire Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

detachments.name: Veiled Blade Elimination Force
detachments.ruleBody:
Officio Assassinorum units from your army can use the Overkill, Soulless Horror and Shieldbreaker abilities twice per battle, instead of once per battle (but cannot use such an ability more than once in the same battle round).

When mustering your army, each OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM unit from your army has the relevant Extremis ability shown below, and you must increase the points cost of each of those units by the amount shown. If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.

Extremis Abilities

The agents of the Callidus Temple are known to utilise vat-grown doubles to confound their foes. CALLIDUS ASSASSIN models only. Twice per battle, in your Movement phase, you can select one other friendly INFANTRY model that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. The selected model is destroyed (ignoring any rules that are triggered when a model is destroyed) and this model is removed from the battlefield and set up again as close as possible to where that destroyed model was and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. This ability cannot be used more than once in the same battle round.

This Culexus operative has been outfitted with various grenades tailored to destroy their assigned targets. CULEXUS ASSASSIN models only. Each time this model is targeted with the Grenades **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**, 1 mortal wound is inflicted for each D6 roll of 3+ instead of for each 4+.

This Eversor agent’s neurons have been surgically spliced to enhance awareness and speed of thought. EVERSOR ASSASSIN model only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention **stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that **stratagem** this phase. If you do:
▪ That use is -1 CP.
▪ That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

These projectiles are tipped with miniaturised melta charges that detonate on impact. VINDICARE ASSASSIN models only. This model’s exitus rifle has the [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] abilities.

stratagems.name: Prime Target
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that attack is made by an Officio Assassinorum model and it targets the enemy WARLORD, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Hyperstimms
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, if it is an Eversor Assassin unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

stratagems.name: Orbital Oversight
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18", or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6".

stratagems.name: Will-sapping Salvo
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, if it is a Culexus Assassin unit, until the end of the phase, change the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit to 3.

stratagems.name: Blind Grenades
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM GRENADES or Vindicare Assassin unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit, or, if your unit is a VINDICARE ASSASSIN, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit instead.

stratagems.name: Ensnaring Trap
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select one or more of those enemy units as the targets of that charge. In addition, if it is a Callidus Assassin unit and it makes a Charge move as a result of this Stratagem, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Deathwatch Veteran with Deathwatch Marksman Bolt Carbine, Special-issue Bolt Pistol and Knives and Fists
Deathwatch Veteran with Stalker Bolt Rifle, Bolt Pistol and Knives and Fists
Deathwatch Veteran with Xenophase Blade and Special-issue Bolt Pistol
