armyRule.name: Waaagh!
armyRule.body:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.
▪ Become **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, as stated in other rules.

While a unit is **riled up**:
▪ That unit has 5+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]**.
▪ That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
▪ When that unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

**War Cry (Once per battle, per army):** At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the **Waaagh!** ability are **riled up** until the end of the next turn.

### Da Boss
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Unstable energies
ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a **[gloss:psyker-level:psyker level]** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic ability]** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that PSYKER unit's **psyker level**.

**Example:** In a battle round, a **psyker level 3** PSYKER unit could use three **psychic level 1** abilities, or one **psychic level 1** ability and one **psychic level 2** ability, or one **psychic level 3** ability.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make: some Orks rules allow a unit to make a **pulse jet move**, as described below. (The **[gloss:assault-disembark-move:assault disembark move]** the codex also lists is a core move type — see Core Rules, 18.06.)

**Pulse Jet Move**
◈ MAXIMUM DISTANCE | **Pulse roll** + 18"
◈ ELIGIBLE IF | As stated in the rule allowing this **move type**.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit moves as described in Moving (Core Rules, 03).
◈ BEFORE MOVING | Make a **pulse roll** by rolling one D6.
◈ WHILE MOVING
▪ Ignore all vertical distance for the purposes of how far your unit has moved.
▪ Your unit can move through all types of model.
▪ Your unit can move horizontally and vertically through all categories of **[gloss:terrain-feature:terrain feature]**.
◈ AFTER MOVING
▪ Your unit must be **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.
▪ Until the end of the turn, your unit is __not__ **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]** or **[gloss:action:start an action]**.
▪ Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

detachments.name: Blitz Brigade
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly WAGON units can re-roll **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.
▪ When a friendly WAGON unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that unit can change **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]** to a 6.

stratagems.name: Readied Brawlers
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]**.
stratagems.target: That WAGON unit.
stratagems.effect: Units embarked within your unit can make an **[gloss:assault-disembark-move:assault disembark move]** (pg 121).

stratagems.name: Impending Krunch
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.
stratagems.target: That WAGON unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.

stratagems.name: Keep It Runnin’
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ORKS INFANTRY unit that was **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]** this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

detachments.name: Brute Bosses
detachments.ruleBody:
When a friendly WARBOSS model is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if this unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to the roll if your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**:
▪ On a 3+, do not remove this WARBOSS model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this WARBOSS model is removed from the battlefield.

detachments.name: Bully Boyz
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ units’ melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
stratagems.target: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a **[gloss:strength:S]** greater than your unit’s **[gloss:toughness:T]** have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Too Arrogant to Die
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
stratagems.target: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**:
▪ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Armed To Da Teef
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ If your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, re-roll **hit rolls**.

detachments.name: Da Big Hunt
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units’ attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.

stratagems.name: Where D’ya Fink You’re Going?
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if that enemy unit is **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.
stratagems.target: That BEAST SNAGGA unit.
stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that enemy unit must use the **[gloss:desperate-escape:desperate escape] **mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard rolls]** for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is **engaged** with, with -1 from those **hazard rolls** if that enemy unit is **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**.

stratagems.name: Goaded Into Action
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6". If your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, it can re-roll that D6.

detachments.name: Dread Mob
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units) is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**, you can use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results). This unit’s attacks have the relevant rule(s):
▪ **1-2:** +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**
▪ **3-4:** +2 **[gloss:strength:S]**
▪ **5-6:** +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**

If you rolled two D6, when this unit has attacked, this unit makes one **[gloss:hazard-roll:hazard roll]**.

stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]** or **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).
stratagems.target: That ORKS WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD:
▪ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Dread Power
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ORKS WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]** until the start of your next turn.

detachments.name: Flyboyz
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units do not count towards the combined points value of your **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]** units.
▪ While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit.
stratagems.effect: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Whirligig Evasion
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of:
▪ Up to D6".
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, up to 6".

stratagems.name: Flyin’ Headbutt
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, before rolling for any [core:Deadly Demise].
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit does not have the [core:Deadly Demise] ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:
▪ For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**. Then remove your unit from the battlefield.

detachments.name: Green Tide
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly BOYZ units’ melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
▪ If a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: NON-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That BOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.

stratagems.name: Mob Mentality
stratagems.when: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock rolls]** are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: ’Ere We Go
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.
stratagems.target: That BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.

detachments.name: Kult of Speed
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly WARBIKERS units have BATTLELINE.
▪ When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**:
▪ That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
▪ That move does not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.
stratagems.target: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]** of 1‑3.

stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit.
stratagems.effect: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** 3 wounds.

detachments.name: Madcap Meks
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Shooting phase, when all of a friendly BIG MEK/MEK GUNZ/MORKANAUT/WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit's ranged attacks target a single enemy unit, roll one D6:
▪ **1 — Dat's Weird:** The target unit has 4+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]** until your unit has shot.
▪ **2-3 — Hop Splat:** Select one other enemy unit within 3" of the target. That unit suffers D3 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
▪ **4 — Seekerz:** Those attacks have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
▪ **5 — Lifted:** The target unit has FLY, and cannot have the **[gloss:benefit-of-cover:benefit of cover]**, until your unit has shot.
▪ **6 — Runtified:** The target unit has -1 **[gloss:toughness:T]** until your unit has shot.

stratagems.name: Vindictive Artillerists
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That MEK GUNZ unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
▪ __Or:__ [HAZARDOUS], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

detachments.name: Runt Swarm
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly GRETCHIN units have BATTLELINE.
▪ When a friendly GRETCHIN unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that move does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.

stratagems.name: Scarper!
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** GRETCHIN unit.
stratagems.target: That GRETCHIN unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of:
▪ Up to D6".
▪ __Or:__ Up to 6" instead if your unit is an **[gloss:attached-unit:attached]** unit.

stratagems.name: Grot Shields
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN units).
stratagems.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: When a **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]** for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

stratagems.name: Infested War Zone
stratagems.when: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**. You can target that unit with this **[gloss:stratagem:stratagem]** even though that unit was just **destroyed**.
stratagems.effect: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** unit, in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**, at its **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]**, with its full wounds remaining.

detachments.name: Shoota Boyz
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units’ ranged attacks have:
▪ [ASSAULT].
▪ While this unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**, +3" **[gloss:range:R]**.

stratagems.name: Kustom Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Glowin’ Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.

stratagems.name: Never Enough Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

detachments.name: Taktikal Brigade
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ Friendly STORMBOYZ units have BATTLELINE.
▪ When a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

stratagems.name: While Their Backs are Turned
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.
stratagems.target: That BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.

stratagems.name: Dubious Restraint
stratagems.when: Start/end of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:objective:objective]** your unit is controlling. That **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**.

detachments.name: War Horde
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Breakin’ Heads
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly **[gloss:attached-unit:attached]** ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle‑shocked]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this **[gloss:stratagem:stratagem]** even though it is **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**.
stratagems.effect:
Roll one D3:
▪ Your unit suffers a number of **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]** equal to the result.
▪ Your unit is no longer **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle‑shocked]**.

stratagems.name: Close-range Dakka
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
▪ [RAPID FIRE 1].
▪ __Or:__ If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is **[gloss:orks-riled-up:riled up]**:
▪ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Mow ’Em Down
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks have:
▪ [CLEAVE 1].
▪ __Or:__ If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.name: Fungus-fuel Injection
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.

stratagems.name: Hit ’Em Harder
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

detachments.name: Wreckas
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, if any of the following apply, that unit’s attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1:
▪ That unit is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
▪ The target of that attack is within range of an **objective**.

stratagems.name: Gun-crazy Show-offs
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One friendly FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using **[gloss:normal-shooting:normal shooting]**, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Drive-By Bustin’
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ORKS TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the [core:Firing Deck] ability have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Grab It
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
▪ Your unit is __not__ **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]** until the end of the turn.

detachments.name: Wurrband
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly ORKS PSYKER models’ [PSYCHIC] attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.
▪ +1 **S** for every 5 models in this unit (or embarked within this model).

Friendly ORKS PSYKER models have the following **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic abilities]**:

**Roar of Mork (psychic level 1):** In your Movement phase, if this unit is not **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**, you can make a **[gloss:psychic-roll:psychic roll]** for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
▪ On a 1, this unit is **battle-shocked**.
▪ Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 from that **battle-shock roll** for every 10 models in this unit.

**Visions of Violence (psychic level 1):** At the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not **battle-shocked**, you can make a **psychic roll** for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
▪ On a 1, this unit is **battle-shocked**.
▪ This unit has [core:Fights First].

armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

### Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

### Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

### Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]** and **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** once per battle.
▪ Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

### Transhuman Strategist
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Librarius
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a **[gloss:psyker-level:psyker level]** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic ability]** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s **psyker level**.

Example: In a battle round, a **psyker level 3** PSYKER unit could use three **psychic level 1** abilities, or one **psychic level 1** ability and one **psychic level 2** ability, or one **psychic level 3** ability.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make:
▪ **[gloss:shock-disembark-move:shock disembark move]** (18.07)
▪ **[gloss:assault-disembark-move:assault disembark move]** (18.06)

detachments.name: Gauntlet Task Force
detachments.ruleBody:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is **[gloss:sm-assailed:assailed]** until the end of the turn:
▪ While a unit is **assailed**, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Storm and Secure
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit that has an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:objective:objective]** your unit is controlling. That **objective** is **[gloss:secured-objective:secured]**.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the **[gloss:set-up-distance:set-up distance]** of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagems.name: Duty is Never Done
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]** this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

detachments.name: Ironclad Champions
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.

stratagems.name: Adamantine Terror
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.

stratagems.name: Mercy is Weakness
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Upstoppable Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]** or **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.
stratagems.target: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

detachments.name: Ironstorm Spearhead
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units’ (excluding WALKER units) ranged attacks can:
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:wound-roll:wound roll]**.

stratagems.name: Might of the machine Spirit
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units).
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
▪ **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.
▪ **[gloss:ballistic-skill:BS]**.
▪ **[gloss:hit-roll:Hit rolls]** and **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Layered Ceramite
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

stratagems.name: Headhunter Doctrine
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units) is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

detachments.name: Tacticus Attack Force
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly TACTICUS units can re-roll **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Transhuman Swiftness
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]** and is **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]**.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Fights First] and __must__ be the next unit you **select to fight**.

stratagems.name: Tactical Focus
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a **[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**.
stratagems.target: That TACTICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: When making that **[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That TACTICUS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
▪ [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
▪ __Or:__ [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

detachments.name: Tacticus Firestorm Force
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly TACTICUS units’ [RAPID FIRE] attacks benefit from [RAPID FIRE] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

stratagems.name: Point-blank Brutality
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** TACTICUS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That TACTICUS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [BLAST] attacks) have:
▪ [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
▪ [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: For the Emperor!
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 **[gloss:objective-control:OC]** until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That TACTICUS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
▪ [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
▪ __Or:__ [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

detachments.name: Stormlance Task Force
detachments.ruleBody: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.

stratagems.name: Hurtling Targets
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Wind-Swift Evasion
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]** this phase.
stratagems.effect:
▪ If your unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]**.
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is **[gloss:engaged:engaged]**, your unit can make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.

stratagems.name: Sudden Onslaught

detachments.ruleBody:
▪ While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**, that unit’s attacks can re-roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.
▪ Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units are **[gloss:sm-entrenched:entrenched]** while all of the following apply:
▪ That unit is within a **terrain area**.
▪ That unit was not set up this turn.
▪ No model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn.
▪ Friendly DARNATH LYSANDER/TOR GARADON units have the following ability:

**Defensive Mastery**: At the start of each phase, this unit is **entrenched**.

Darnath Lysander's/Tor Garadon's unit is always **entrenched**, regardless of the conditions listed above.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include IMPERIAL FISTS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is **[gloss:sm-entrenched:entrenched]**, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect:

Your unit is __not__ able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

**Designer’s Note:** This means your unit can move out of **[gloss:engagement-range:engagement range]** with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the

**objective consolidation mode**.

detachments.ruleBody:

▪ If that unit is within 6" of a friendly CANNOK VAR/IRON FATHER FEIRROS unit you can:
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:wound-roll:wound roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:damage-roll:damage roll]**.
▪ Otherwise you can:
▪ Re-roll __one__ **hit roll**.
▪ __Or:__ Re-roll __one__ **wound roll**.
▪ __Or:__ Re-roll __one__ **damage roll**.

stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of:
▪ Up to D6”.
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit, up to 6”.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: The **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:tactical doctrine]** is active for your unit in addition to any other **combat doctrine**, until the start of your next Command phase.

detachments.name: Forgefather's Seekers
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ You can select the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:devastator doctrine]** one additional time per battle.
▪ Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12”, have +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.

If your army includes a VULKAN HE’STAN unit, friendly INFERNUS SQUAD units have the following:
▪ When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **advance/fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.
▪ When this unit **[gloss:action:starts an action]**, that **action** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include SALAMANDERS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Crucible of Battle
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]** an enemy unit within 6”.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.

stratagems.name: Immolation Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1**[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.

stratagems.name: Burning Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:
▪ Make a **[gloss:disembark:disembark move]**.
▪ Shoot using **[gloss:normal-shooting:normal shooting]**, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Blazing Earth
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more TORRENT/MELTA weapons.
stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has ‑1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Forged in Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s TORRENT weapons:
▪ Do not have [BLAST].
▪ Have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
▪ Have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.

stratagems.name: Wrath and Ruin
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: The **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** __or__ **tactical doctrine** is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

detachments.name: Spearpoint Task Force
detachments.ruleBody:
▪ You can select the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** __or__ **tactical doctrine** one additional time per battle.
▪ Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +1 to **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.

Friendly SUBODEN KHAN units have the following ability:

**Wrath of the First Khan:** At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]** this phase, you can use this ability. If you do:
▪ If this unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, this unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]**.
▪ __Or:__ If this unit is **[gloss:engaged:engaged]**, this unit can make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include WHITE SCARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: Withdraw and Regroup
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.

stratagems.name: Hunter's Instincts
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3”.

stratagems.name: Spear Thrust and Sabre Swing
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks:
▪ Have [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ Have [LANCE].
▪ __Or:__ If your unit has MOUNTED, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].

stratagems.name: Flawless Riders
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]** or **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Evasive Manoeuvers
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

stratagems.name: Mobile Lethality
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
▪ That **fall-back** move does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.
▪ Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

### Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

### Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

### Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]** and **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** once per battle.
▪ Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

### Transhuman Strategist
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Curse of the Wulfen
While this unit is within 6” of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or within 12” of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, if this unit is not **[gloss:battle-shocked:battle-shocked]**:
▪ If this unit has INFANTRY, this unit has +1 **[gloss:objective-control:OC]**.
▪ If this unit has VEHICLE, this unit has +3 **OC**.

Bestial Forms: For the purposes of **[gloss:transport-capacity:transport capacity]**, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

### Sons of Russ
Your army cannot include APOTHECARY units.

detachments.name: Saga of the Great Wolf
detachments.ruleBody:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLES units) with this ability have the following abilities:

**Encircling Jaws**: If the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** is active for your unit, your unit has +1 to **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]** and **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

**Hunter’s Eye**: If the **devastator doctrine** is active for your unit, your unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.

**Ferocious Strike**: If the **tactical doctrine** is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit with 9” have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Friendly LOGAN GRIMNAR units have the following ability:

**Howling Onslaught**: **(Once per battle, per army)** In your command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER/VEHICLE units benefit from the **Master of Wolves** rule until the start of your next command phase.

**Restrictions**: Your army can include SPACE WOLVES units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
